abstract: Maintains environmental impact assessments and municipal ground ecological permits
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance lead (ENVR). You serve as the Environmental compliance lead (ENVR), responsible for maintaining environmental impact assessments, tracking municipal ground ecological permits, and recording acoustic perimeter surveys across candidate district heating projects.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic perimeter monitoring（NOISE）
information_points.content:
ENVR-NOISE-S10：Acoustic survey records show the Deep geothermal doublet and heat recovery scheme has an A-weighted equivalent nighttime boundary sound pressure level of 45 dB along the facility perimeter between 22:00 and 06:00.
ENVR-NOISE-YJ0：For the Open-loop aquifer thermal storage and heat pump scheme, the measured nighttime boundary sound pressure level along the facility perimeter between 22:00 and 06:00 is 42 dB.
ENVR-NOISE-1IU：For the Co-located hydrothermal extraction and absorption scheme, the nighttime boundary sound pressure level at the facility perimeter between 22:00 and 06:00 stands at 50 dB.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental impact assessments and municipal ground ecological permits（ECOL）
information_points.content:
ENVR-ECOL-9XF：For the Co-located hydrothermal extraction and absorption scheme, statutory environmental impact clearance has been granted covering the district heating plant and pipeline easement corridor.
ENVR-ECOL-NZS：For the Open-loop aquifer thermal storage and heat pump scheme, statutory environmental impact clearance has not been granted for the district heating plant and pipeline easement corridor.
ENVR-ECOL-ZCF：For the Deep geothermal doublet and heat recovery scheme, statutory environmental impact clearance has been granted for the district heating plant and pipeline easement corridor.
